title: Meal Prepping 101: Chicken & Dumplin' Soup
seo_title: Meal Prepping 101: Chicken & Dumplin' Soup Class
description: This is a hands-on meal prep workshop where each guest works with Chef Zach to make their own four-quart batch of Chicken & Dumplin' Soup, learning how to build flavor and prepare ingredients for a one-pot recipe. Guests leave with four quarts of finished soup and a take-home recipe. It takes place Tuesday, January 5, 2027, from 6:00 to 8:00 PM at The Ozark Mill at Finley Farms, 802 Finley Farms Lane, Ozark, Missouri.
